newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mixed in after-hours trade on Friday, as small-lot bargain-hunting buyng in distant months helped prices rebound from the day's lows, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.7 yen per kg lower to 0.4 yen higher than the day's close. Volume was 8,164 lots.
During the day, prices edged lower as selling ahead of the spot expiry on next Monday pressured the market.
A view that the yen is unlikely to fall sharply against the dollar, and weaker overseas markets reflecting slack physical demand, undermined market sentiment.
